title: acceptance-property.v1
description: Normalized acceptance property produced by the property projector from an approved spec criterion. Carries authority reference, subject selector, observation requirements, freshness scope, satisfaction and contradiction rules, and the evidence policy version. Invalid projection blocks evaluation, not authoring. One authority per property.

schema_version.description: Schema major version. Readers reject unknown major versions and recompute after reader upgrade.

property_id.description: Stable criterion identifier derived from the spec. Changes only through approved spec amendment.

spec_ref.description: Spec identity reference for the criterion authority.

authority_ref.description: Current approval for this criterion, spec, and evidence policy. Initial plan review and later task projections do not grant criterion authority.

subject_selector.description: Canonical paths or artifact identities plus the fingerprint algorithm that binds evidence.

paths_or_artifacts.description: Canonical paths or artifact identity references.

fingerprint_algorithm.description: Algorithm name used to compute the subject fingerprint.

required_observations.description: Named observation terms with type, producer class, outcomes, count, and permitted freshness mode or completeness attestor.

term.description: Canonical term name referenced in satisfaction and contradiction rules.

observation_type.description: Type of observation (e.g., test-result, command-result, manual-observation).

producer_class.description: Class of producer permitted to supply this observation.

count.description: Required number of observations. Absent means one.

freshness_mode.description: Permitted freshness mode for this term. Absent means exact-subject.

completeness_attestor.description: Named completeness attestor for path-set freshness. Absent forces exact-subject.

freshness_scope.description: Property-level freshness scope. Either exact-subject or canonical path-set; no adapter-defined third mode.

satisfaction_rule.description: Canonical all, any, or at-least expression over named observation terms. No executable code.

expression.description: Canonical satisfaction expression (all, any, or at-least) over named terms.

contradiction_rule.description: Canonical expression over normalized contradictory outcomes, evaluated before satisfaction. Every property includes the reserved supported-review-failure term.

expression.description: Canonical contradiction expression over named terms including supported-review-failure.

policy_version.description: Schema and evaluator semantics version selected by the approving authority.
